crossRefs.note: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her…
It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land…
“Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause…
You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

translations.web: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
translations.bsb: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.”
translations.kjv: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
translations.asv: They shall be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother in law against her daughter in law, and daughter in law against her mother in law.
